name: Cheese
summary: **Cheese** is a [[kind:cut|cut]], a single clone selected from a pack of [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]] seeds by an anonymous grower in England in the late 1980s. The clone spread through the UK cannabis scene from the mid-1990s by way of the Exodus Collective, a community group near Luton. [[breeder:Big Buddha Seeds]] later crossed it with an [[afghani|Afghani]] male to release it as seed.

sources.title: UK Cheese: Breeder, Origin & Lineage
sources.note: L1-C audit 2026-09-25: confirms the Chiltern Hills Skunk #1 selection (1988-89), the Exodus Collective from about 1995, and Big Buddha's cross of the clone with an Afghani male.
